The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMER Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the PGIMER Recruitment 2026 is 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this PGIMER recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Resident (Community Medicine) and Junior Demonstrator (Epidemiology).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For Senior Resident (Community Medicine), an MD in Community Medicine is required. For Junior Demonstrator (Epidemiology), an MSc in Epidemiology or MPH is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted in Chandigarh, as per the details in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for these posts will be as per PGIMER rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The official notification should be checked for specific details regarding domicile requirements, but generally, government job notifications are open to eligible candidates from all states.
